## Admin cutover polish shipped and verified

- UTC completed: 2026-10-21T17:35Z.
- PR #177 (`Admin cutover polish: branded entry and password controls`) merged as `10f68f7f`; CI `validate` and `route-fixtures` passed; deploy run `39642032815` succeeded.
- Public branded entry is live: `https://launchloom.wrazyos.com/admin/` returns 200, is `noindex`, and redirects to `https://launchloom-api.dark-sound-e4eb.workers.dev/admin/login`. The Worker login shell returns 200 and signed-out workspace requests redirect to login.
- Password controls: Settings now exposes current/new/confirm password fields and uses the provider's `change-password` proxy with `revokeOtherSessions`. Emailed reset requests use the canonical `request-password-reset` route, and reset tokens are read once, scrubbed from the address, redeemed, and never stored. Expected auth 401/400 responses were observed; one non-blocking WebKit CSP stylesheet console warning occurred during the login transition; a direct settings reload produced no console errors. Screenshot: `/home/zahemen/.local/share/launchloom-private/prod-webkit-settings.png`. The synthetic admin, membership, audit row and auth user were deleted; readback was `members=0`, `users=0`. No client records or client actions were touched.
- Reconciliation dry run run `39636836354` completed: 8 reads, 0 upserts, 365 unassociated-run warnings, no errors, no writes. Authorized backfill write run `39644063940` completed: 8 reads, 0 upserts, 372 warnings, no errors. No attempt or actor metadata was invented; the retained runs lacked parseable LLGEN routing, so the write recorded reconciliation health without fabricating history. The workflow sink now uses `ADMIN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` (the public Worker origin) instead of the Access-protected API host.
- Live reset request after deployment returned 200. A fresh reset message was requested for `david@maigreeks.com`; mailbox delivery and token expiry still need user-side confirmation.
